2025/08/amazon-ecr-supports-100000-image: Raises the existing repository image limit from 20,000 to 100,000.

2026/08/aws-direct-connect-new-prefix-co: Adds route-prefix capacity pools and per-interface allocation controls as well as raising the ceiling.

2025/06/amazon-q-developer-eclipse-ide-p: Provides existing Q Developer capabilities within an additional IDE.
2025/04/iam-identity-center-sdk-plugin-s: Automates existing trusted-identity token exchange through an SDK plugin.
2026/02/amazon-location-service-introduc: Packages instructions and patterns for using existing Location APIs in additional development tools.
2026/10/aws-lambda-durable-go-sdk-suppor: Exposes the existing durable-execution programming model through a Go SDK.
2025/01/aws-marketplace-8-decimal-place-: Raises supported seller-configured pricing precision from three to eight decimal places.
2025/02/custom-payment-schedules-marketp: Adds per-installment payment controls in the Portal and Catalog API, replacing a uniform markup constraint.
2025/11/amazon-workspaces-applications-i: Adds custom EC2 AMI import to WorkSpaces image creation, alongside additional compute choices and configurable storage.
